methods_menu_final.M5: Newey-West lag max(2h,60) with Student-t critical value, df = max(5, floor(n / lag) - 1) (fixed-b style: the degrees of freedom reflect the number of lag-length blocks, not the naive sample size)

methods_menu_final.M8: Fisher z-transform, then the batch-means t-test of M6
